restaurants.name: The League Kitchen & Tavern – Belterra
restaurants.description: Upscale-but-casual neighborhood tavern with a vintage sports vibe, scratch-made American comfort food, great burgers, and a big bar program. Ideal for an easy lunch or dinner close to the house.
restaurants.address: 166 Hargraves Dr, Suite B300, Austin, TX 78737
restaurants.imageAlt: Cozy restaurant interior with leather booths and a busy bar

restaurants.name: Cousin Louie's Italian American
restaurants.description: Lively Italian-American spot from the TC4 hospitality group serving handmade pastas, classic red-sauce favorites, and big family-style platters. Great for a celebratory dinner without driving into downtown.
restaurants.address: 165 Hargraves Dr, Suite T100, Austin, TX 78737
restaurants.imageAlt: Italian restaurant table with pasta, salad, and wine

restaurants.name: Franklin Barbecue
restaurants.description: Legendary Austin barbecue joint famous for impossibly tender brisket, ribs, and sausages. Expect a line, but many visitors make it a bucket-list experience for Texas BBQ.
restaurants.imageAlt: Barbecue platter with brisket, ribs, and sides on butcher paper

restaurants.name: Austin Taco Project
restaurants.description: Creative taco bar in the Hilton Austin with playful fillings, shareable apps, craft cocktails, and arcade-style games. Fun downtown stop before or after events.
restaurants.imageAlt: Colorful tacos and cocktails on a wooden table

restaurants.name: Moonshine Patio Bar & Grill
restaurants.description: Classic Austin restaurant in a historic downtown building serving elevated Southern comfort food, big brunches, and cocktails on a shaded patio steps from the Convention Center.
restaurants.imageAlt: Outdoor patio restaurant under string lights in the evening

restaurants.name: Odd Duck
restaurants.description: Celebrated farm-to-table restaurant known for creative small plates, wood-fired cooking, and a constantly changing seasonal menu. A top choice for a special night out in South Austin.
restaurants.imageAlt: Modern restaurant table with shared small plates and drinks

coffee.name: Ani's Day & Night
coffee.description: Colorful house-turned-hangout with all-day coffee, cocktails, food trucks, and a big yard filled with picnic tables and shade. Great for remote work by day and low-key drinks at night.
coffee.imageAlt: Outdoor bar and coffee space with picnic tables and string lights

coffee.name: Café Crème – Oltorf
coffee.description: French-Vietnamese café known for beautiful latte art, sweet and savory crêpes, pastries, and a relaxed neighborhood vibe. Good option before heading into town or after a morning on the trail.
coffee.imageAlt: Latte and crepe on a small café table

coffee.name: Spokesman Coffee – South
coffee.description: Hip coffee shop and roastery in the St. Elmo district with plenty of seating, rotating taps of beer, and a fun industrial vibe. Great stop if you are already heading up 290 toward downtown.
coffee.address: 440 E Saint Elmo Rd, Suite A-2, Austin, TX 78745
coffee.imageAlt: Barista pouring latte art in a modern coffee shop

coffee.name: Cosmic Coffee + Beer Garden
coffee.description: Beloved South Austin hangout with specialty coffee, a full bar, food trucks, and lush garden spaces with chickens and ponds. Perfect for groups who want coffee, cocktails, and casual food in one spot.
coffee.imageAlt: Outdoor garden patio with picnic tables, trees, and lights

coffee.name: Civil Goat Coffee – Manor
coffee.description: Local coffee roaster with excellent espresso drinks, house-roasted beans, and a cozy East Austin café. Known for its friendly vibe and, at some locations, resident goats that kids love.
coffee.imageAlt: Cappuccino on a table in a bright coffee shop

groceries.name: H-E-B Nutty Brown (Belterra Area)
groceries.description: Full-service Texas grocery store with a wide selection of everyday items, beer and wine, bakery, pharmacy, and curbside pickup. This is the closest and most convenient main grocery option to the home.
groceries.imageAlt: Grocery store aisle with produce and shoppers

groceries.name: Trader Joe's – Arboretum
groceries.description: Popular specialty grocer for snacks, frozen meals, wine, and unique pantry items. Best paired with a trip to the surrounding Arboretum shopping and dining area.
groceries.address: 9722 Great Hills Trl, Suite 200, Austin, TX 78759
groceries.imageAlt: Grocery store shelves with colorful packaged foods

groceries.name: Trader Joe's – Rollingwood / Bee Cave Road
groceries.description: Another Trader Joe's location convenient to downtown and Westlake, great for grabbing wine, cheese, and snacks on your way back to the rental from central Austin.
groceries.imageAlt: Person shopping in a grocery store produce section

hiking.name: Lady Bird Lake & Ann and Roy Butler Hike-and-Bike Trail
hiking.description: Ten miles of lakeside trail circling Lady Bird Lake in downtown Austin, popular with walkers, runners, and cyclists. You can also rent kayaks, canoes, or paddleboards to enjoy the skyline from the water.
hiking.imageAlt: People walking and biking on a lakeside path with city skyline views

hiking.name: Barton Springs Pool
hiking.description: Iconic spring-fed pool in Zilker Park with clear, cool water year-round. Locals and visitors come to swim, sunbathe on the grassy hill, and cool off after a day exploring Austin.
hiking.imageAlt: Large natural swimming pool with people swimming and lounging on grassy banks

hillCountry.name: Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center
hillCountry.description: State Botanic Garden of Texas with trails, meadows, and seasonal wildflower displays, about 20 minutes from the property. Great for gentle walks, photography, and family-friendly events.
hillCountry.imageAlt: Blooming trees and flowers along a path at Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center

hillCountry.name: Wild Basin Wilderness Preserve
hillCountry.description: 227-acre Hill Country preserve with about 3 miles of hiking trails, creek crossings, and overlooks. A quieter alternative to the more famous parks, focused on conservation and low-impact visits.
hillCountry.address: 805 N Capital of Texas Hwy, Austin, TX 78746
hillCountry.imageAlt: Small waterfall flowing into a shaded pool at Wild Basin Wilderness Preserve

hillCountry.name: Hamilton Pool Preserve
hillCountry.description: Iconic Texas Hill Country grotto with a jade-green pool, waterfall, and dramatic limestone overhang. Reservations are required; swimming access varies depending on conditions.
hillCountry.address: 24300 Hamilton Pool Rd, Dripping Springs, TX 78620
hillCountry.imageAlt: Natural pool beneath a rocky grotto with a waterfall at Hamilton Pool Preserve

hillCountry.name: Covert Park at Mount Bonnell
hillCountry.description: Short stair climb to one of Austin's classic overlooks with sweeping views of the Colorado River, Lake Austin, and downtown skyline. Popular for sunsets and photos.
hillCountry.imageAlt: View of the Austin skyline and river from the summit of Mount Bonnell at Covert Park

parks.name: Wild Basin Wilderness Preserve
parks.description: A 227-acre nature preserve with shaded oak-juniper forest trails, creek crossings, and Hill Country wildlife. Perfect for quiet morning hikes, bird-watching, and photography. Note: Dogs are not allowed to protect endangered habitat.
parks.address: 805 N Capital of Texas Hwy, Austin, TX 78746
parks.imageAlt: Small waterfall and rocky stream surrounded by trees at Wild Basin Wilderness Preserve

parks.name: McKinney Falls State Park
parks.description: A scenic state park featuring waterfalls, natural limestone pools along Onion Creek, shaded picnic areas, hiking and biking trails, and wildlife viewing. Swimming and wading access vary by season and park conditions.
parks.imageAlt: Water flowing over limestone ledges at McKinney Falls State Park

downtown.name: Zilker Metropolitan Park
downtown.description: Austin's central green space with wide open fields, playgrounds, picnic areas, and skyline views. Home to festivals, the Zilker Zephyr train area, Barton Springs Pool, and the trail along Lady Bird Lake.
downtown.imageAlt: Large city park with people relaxing on the grass and skyline in the background

downtown.name: Zilker Botanical Garden
downtown.description: Beautiful botanical garden inside Zilker Park featuring themed areas like a Japanese garden, rose garden, and cactus collections. A peaceful spot for photos, strolling, and enjoying Hill Country plants.
downtown.imageAlt: Pathway through a lush garden with flowers and trees

downtown.name: Rainey Street Historic District
downtown.description: Famous downtown strip of converted bungalow bars and restaurants. Expect food trucks, patios, live music, and a fun nightlife scene steps from the lake trail and new waterfront developments.
downtown.imageAlt: Nighttime street scene with lit-up bungalow bars and people walking

downtown.name: Red River Cultural District
downtown.description: Lively downtown corridor packed with live music venues, bars, and late-night eats. Great place to catch a local band, from indie rock to metal, and experience Austin's music scene.
downtown.address: Red River St between 6th and 12th, Austin, TX 78701
downtown.imageAlt: Live music venue exterior with neon signs at night

downtown.name: Downtown Austin Walking Tour & Live Music Night
downtown.description: Create your own evening walking loop through downtown: start near the Texas State Capitol, stroll down Congress Avenue to the river, then branch off to 6th Street, Red River, or Rainey Street for live music and late-night bites.
downtown.address: Texas State Capitol, 1100 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701 (suggested starting point)
downtown.imageAlt: Downtown city street at dusk with cars, people, and lit buildings

localSpots.name: The Switch BBQ & Craft House
localSpots.description: A Hill Country favorite serving Texas BBQ with a Cajun influence — brisket, gumbo, house sausage, and great cocktails. Casual, family-friendly, and close to the property.
localSpots.address: 166 Hargraves Dr Suite H100, Austin, TX 78737
localSpots.imageAlt: Texas barbecue plate at The Switch BBQ with brisket, pickles, and sides

localSpots.name: Homespun Kitchen & Bar
localSpots.description: Fresh, farm-to-table comfort food with a small-town Texas atmosphere. Brunch, live music nights, and outdoor seating make it a charming local favorite.
localSpots.address: 131 E Mercer St, Dripping Springs, TX 78620
localSpots.imageAlt: Outdoor seating area at Homespun Kitchen & Bar with live music setup

localSpots.name: Vista Brewing
localSpots.description: A craft brewery and ranch-style property with onsite honey, gardens, a beer hall, and weekend live music. A perfect Hill Country afternoon spot.
localSpots.imageAlt: Vista Brewing outdoor beer garden with picnic tables and Hill Country scenery

localSpots.name: Pieous Pizza
localSpots.description: Beloved Austin pizzeria known for wood-fired Neapolitan pies, homemade pastrami, fresh sourdough, and a relaxed family atmosphere.
localSpots.address: 166 Hargraves Dr Ste G300, Austin, TX 78737
localSpots.imageAlt: Wood-fired pizza and fresh house-made sourdough bread at Pieous

localSpots.name: Jester King Brewery
localSpots.description: Iconic farmhouse brewery and outdoor venue offering sour beers, wood-fired pizza, goats, trails, and fire pits — a uniquely Austin experience.
localSpots.imageAlt: Outdoor tables and farmhouse brewery setting at Jester King with visitors and goats

localSpots.name: Driftwood Dugout
localSpots.description: Quirky, super-local beer and food trailer park with casual drinks, rotating food trucks, and live music — feels like a true local hangout.
localSpots.imageAlt: Outdoor beer garden with picnic tables and string lights at Driftwood Dugout

transportation.driving: The property is easily accessible by car. From downtown Austin, take Highway 290 West for approximately 20 minutes.
transportation.rideSharing: Uber and Lyft are available in the area. Expect a 20-30 minute ride from downtown Austin.
transportation.parking: Parking is available on the property. Please park in designated areas.
transportation.carRental: Car rental services are available at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport and in downtown Austin.
